part.text:
Fixed `CarbonInterval` totals for date-derived intervals in `src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php`.

`total()` now applies the interval’s `invert` flag when calculating totals from `startDate`/`endDate`. This keeps signed diffs negative while ensuring `diff(..., true)` is positive, so:

```php
Carbon::now()->addDays(15)->diff(Carbon::now(), true)
    ->lte(CarbonInterval::minutes(30));
```

now returns `false`.

```text
./vendor/bin/phpunit tests/CarbonInterval/TotalTest.php tests/CarbonInterval/ComparisonTest.php
OK (53 tests, 204 assertions)
```
